discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators and the quantum spin Hall effect
rationale: Topological insulators are a field-defining condensed-matter discovery from the mid-2000s with extensive citations and major prizes already awarded (Breakthrough, Dirac, Oliver Buckley). They are also a natural follow-on to the 2016 topological phases prize. The 2023-2025 prizes went to attosecond, machine learning and quantum-circuit topics, so the rotation points back to condensed matter. Kane and Mele predicted the Z2 quantum spin Hall state, and Molenkamp's group observed it in HgTe quantum wells; Shoucheng Zhang's death leaves this as the clearest three-person citation.
